changelog: Implemented authentic Opera Red pill chat composer: 56dp min-height, Opera Red (#FF1A1A), 20dp radius, 2px border, red glow shadow, white [+] and [Mic] buttons, white text, and right arrow forward send button
Floating Opera model selector chip above composer and seamless top attachment drawer
Fixed in-app APK auto-updater repository URLs to point to active ejjeejduddu-arch/Antigravity-App repository
Silenced unofficial build toast notification on app launch
Upgraded application launcher icon and splash branding to official Antigravity dark squircle rainbow arch icon
Removed all informal emojis across the application UI and replaced them with premium Material vector icons
Integrated full Opera Design System: Opera Red (#FF1A1A) interaction color, warm cream editorial canvas (#FEFBF6), and sleek dark mode (#0F0F0E)
Added authentic Opera fonts: Petrona (display serif), Figtree (reading sans), and Fragment Mono (UI chrome)
New animated Opera App Opening Splash Screen with glowing aura, spring scale entrance, and smooth wipe reveal
